title.zh: 【索尼旗下 L2 Soneium 上线 ipUSD 与 IP Vault，用户可在链上购买音乐版权基金】
title.en: 【索尼旗下 L2 Soneium 上线 ipUSD 与 IP Vault，用户可在链上购买音乐版权基金】

current_state.zh: Sony's Soneium L2 launched the ipUSD stablecoin and IP Vault, giving qualified users exposure to a $549M music and entertainment royalty fund managed by Partners Group with an estimated 7–9% annual yield.
current_state.en: Sony's Soneium L2 launched the ipUSD stablecoin and IP Vault, giving qualified users exposure to a $549M music and entertainment royalty fund managed by Partners Group with an estimated 7–9% annual yield.
